definitions.explanation: Indicates that something happened only a very short time ago.
Emphasizes the present moment, often stressing immediacy.

examples.japanese: たった{今|いま}⟦{着|つ}いた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧だ。
examples.english: I just got here right now.

examples.japanese: たった{今|いま}⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: There was a phone call just now.

examples.japanese: たった{今|いま}{田中|たなか}さん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧きた。
examples.english: Tanaka-san just left a moment ago, but he's already back.

examples.japanese: たった{今|いま}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{始|はじ}める。
たった{今|いま}、⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧なこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}した→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: Right this moment, I remembered something important.

examples.japanese: たった{今|いま}⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧んだ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I just decided this very moment — I'm going to move next month.

notes:
An emphatic form of ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧. The word ⟦たった→たった：00403_tatta⟧ adds emphasis meaning "just" or "only," making the time reference more immediate than ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧ alone. Very common in everyday conversation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- たった{今|いま}〜た⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧だ: just did something right now
- たった{今|いま}〜たばかりだ: only just did something
- たった{今|いま}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: starting right now

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{今|いま}しがた→今しがた：06930_imashigata⟧: just now — slightly more formal
- ⟦さっき→さっき：01264_sakki⟧: a while ago — refers to a slightly more distant past than たった{今|いま}
- ⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧: just now, right now — similar but less emphatic
